info.title: Family Hub API
info.description: Multi-tenant family-coordination API. This spec is generated from the live Hono route table (FHS-356): every endpoint here is a real, mounted route.

kidAuth.description: Kid PIN session token from POST /api/auth/kid-pin.

post.summary: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes the caller's family and all its data; admin-only

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { deleted: true } on success. 400 CONFIRM_MISMATCH if `confirm` does not exactly equal the family name: nothing is deleted in that case

get.summary: Download the family's full data as one JSON file (GDPR data portability); admin-only

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: Content-Disposition: attachment. { exportedAt, family, data }: data has one array per tenant-scoped table (e.g. members, tasks, habits, habitStickers), each row filtered to this tenant only

get.summary: The family's app_settings map, plus its currency under the `currency` key

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { [key]: value }: includes appName/appSubtitle (if set) and always includes currency (from tenants.currency, default USD)

put.summary: Upsert one setting; admin-only. `currency` writes tenants.currency, not app_settings

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: For key=currency: { key, value } where value is the 3-letter ISO 4217 code just saved. Otherwise the upserted app_settings row

get.summary: List the family's assignments (homework/chores); any member
get.description: Ordered by due date ascending (undated last), then created_at: open/overdue assignments sit on top, undated ones trail behind.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: Success

post.summary: Create an assignment; admin/adult only

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

patch.summary: Toggle an assignment done/not-done; admin/adult only
patch.description: `done: true` stamps doneAt to now; `false` clears it.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: 404 if the assignment is not in this tenant

put.summary: Replace an assignment's title/notes/dueDate/assignee; admin/adult only
put.description: Completion state (done/doneAt) is owned by PATCH and left untouched here, so editing a done assignment keeps it done.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: 404 if the assignment is not in this tenant

post.summary: Exchange a kid PIN for a kid session token

200.description: Success

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: An absolute ICS subscribe URL for Google / Apple / Outlook

post.summary: Regenerate the calendar feed key (admin-only); invalidates old subscriptions

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: The new subscribe URL. Every previously issued URL (old key) 404s from the public feed endpoint from this point on

get.summary: Everything the Today/Dashboard tab renders, in one round-trip
get.description: Bundles the roster, per-kid habit progress, weekly streaks, pending-task counts, a Today's Snapshot stat row, savings goals, and a merged Recent Activity feed (tasks, meals, calendar activities, habit stickers and approved reward redemptions, newest 5) instead of fanning out to five separate endpoints.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: `date` is "today" in the family’s timezone; `counts.tasksTotalToday` is tasks done today plus every still-open task

get.summary: The family's calendar activities for a week (?weekStart=YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: weekStart
parameters.description: Monday of the week to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: One entry per occurrence in the 7-day window. A weekly-recurring series (recurrenceDays set) contributes one entry per matching weekday, all sharing the same series id, with isRecurring: true

post.summary: Create a calendar activity; admin/adult only
post.description: Optional recurrenceDays (weekdays 0=Sun..6=Sat) + recurrenceEndDate turn it into a weekly-repeating series anchored on `date`. No occurrence rows are stored: GET expands the series on read.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

201.description: 201: the created event (the series anchor, if recurring)

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

204.description: 204 on success. For a recurring series this deletes the WHOLE series. 404 if not found in this tenant

put.summary: Replace an event (full update); admin/adult only
put.description: For a recurring series this edits the WHOLE series (start date, weekdays, end date, and all other fields): not a single occurrence. Single-occurrence editing is a follow-up.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: Success

delete.description: memberId in the body scopes the delete, so a caller cannot delete another child’s habit.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug

delete.description: Any grown-up, or the member themself. Removing a past day, or any day in a finalized week, is admin-only (FHS-335).

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

post.description: Any grown-up, or the member themself. Editing a past day, or any day in a finalized week, is admin-only (FHS-335). stickerValue is derived from the habit’s boost, not the request.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

post.summary: Invite someone to the family; admin or adult only
post.description: role is one of admin | adult | teen | guest (default adult). Granting 'admin' requires the caller to already be an admin (403 otherwise): FHS-486 / ADR 0019.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

post.summary: Resend a still-pending invitation email; admin or adult only
post.description: Re-fires the Supabase invite email (e.g. a typo'd address, or the email got lost). 404 if the invitation is not in this tenant; 409 if it is no longer pending (already accepted/expired).

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { resent: true }

post.summary: Claim invites addressed to the caller's own email
post.description: Called right after sign-in when the caller has no membership yet. For each matching pending invitation, links an unclaimed seat (or creates one, for a members-page invite with no pre-created seat) to the caller and flips the invitation to accepted. No tenant header required: the invitation rows carry the tenant scope.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: claimed[]: one entry per family the caller just joined (empty if none matched)

get.summary: A member's journal entry for one day, plus that day's quote index; the member themself, or an admin/adult

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: UUID of the member whose journal is being read

parameters.name: date

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: entry is null if nothing was saved for that day; quoteIndex is always computed from the date. 404 if memberId is not in this tenant; 403 if the caller may not view this member

put.description: quoteIndex is computed server-side from entryDate: the caller cannot set it. Keyed on (tenantId, memberId, entryDate), so a repeat call for the same day overwrites rather than duplicates.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: The saved entry, after the upsert. 404 if memberId is not in this tenant

delete.description: Their content (tasks, habits, etc.) cascades with them. The last remaining admin can never be removed. 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { deleted: true }

patch.summary: Rename a member and/or toggle their admin↔adult role; admin only
patch.description: role may only move between admin and adult (kid roles are fixed at creation). The target must already be adult/admin to be touched; an admin can't demote themselves, and the last remaining admin can never be demoted or removed. 400 with a reason when a guard blocks the change; 404 if the member is not in this tenant.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: The updated member row

post.summary: Start changing a grown-up member's sign-in email; admin-only
post.description: Emails a one-time confirm link to the NEW address, plus a best-effort heads-up notice to the OLD address (never blocks this response). The old address keeps working until the link is clicked. 400 NO_LOGIN_EMAIL if the target has no linked login; 409 if the new email already belongs to a Family Hub account, or if a concurrent request for the same member won the race.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { pendingEmail }: the address the confirm link was sent to

post.summary: Cancel the caller's own pending sign-in email change; self-serve only
post.description: 403 if the target id is not the caller's own member row. Always 200, even if there was nothing pending.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: { cancelled: true }: always, even if there was nothing pending

delete.summary: Clear a kid member's login PIN; admin or adult only
delete.description: Also flips isChild off and clears any existing lockout bucket.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: The member row with hasPin: false

put.summary: Set a kid member's 4-digit login PIN; admin or adult only
put.description: The target must have role child or teen (403 PIN_TARGET_INELIGIBLE otherwise). Setting a PIN also flips isChild on. Clears any existing lockout from prior wrong attempts.

parameters.name: x-tenant-slug
parameters.description: The family's URL slug, e.g. khan-family.

200.description: Success

post.summary: Apply a pending email change from the emailed confirm link
post.description: PUBLIC: the recipient may not be signed in. The token is the credential (its SHA-256 hash is matched server-side); single-use and expires 24h after the admin started the change. Sends a best-effort completion notice to the OLD address on success (never blocks this response). The web ConfirmEmail screen requires an explicit click before calling this: it never auto-fires on page load, so an email link-scanner prefetch cannot burn the token.

200.description: 200 on success. 410 { error: "expired" } if the link is missing/used/expired: the recipient should ask an admin for a new one. 502/500 { errorCode: "EMAIL_CHANGE_APPLY_FAILED" } on a transient failure (Supabase hiccup, or a post-apply drift): the token may still be valid, so the caller should retry rather than treat it as expired.
